comparison.objective: Calibrate a mounted tool tip by making stable contact from four angular poses; candidate screens finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: Submillimetre contact positioning and repeated orientation control versus bimanual load sharing, pouring, and bridge-clearing agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Four distinct 1 s contact poses within force, position, lean, and stability limits versus ≥98% recovery with retained washers and a released screen.
comparison.reason: Contact calibration and granular separation have no meaningful objective or success-condition equivalence.
